name: justclip
description: Clip videos and live streams, create Beat Edits, and use JustClip AI Studio from Claude, Cursor, Codex and other local MCP clients.
long_description: Turn YouTube, Twitch and Kick videos or local files into short clips. Includes live clipping, caption variants, Beat Edits, and AI image and video generation. Video downloads run locally with yt-dlp before uploading to JustClip. Authorize your JustClip account in the browser on first use. A JustClip account and sufficient credits are required. yt-dlp and ffmpeg must be installed separately for local video downloads.

tools.name: account
tools.description: Plan, credits left (and what AI can spend), biggest upload, consent status.

tools.name: clip_video
tools.description: A YouTube/Twitch/Kick URL or a local file. Videos download on your machine and upload; a live Twitch/Kick channel is clipped live.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: Recent projects with status, length and clip count.

tools.name: project_status
tools.description: Processing status and how many clips are ready.

tools.name: list_clips
tools.description: Clips with hook, score, duration and render status; marks any locked by the plan's export cap.

tools.name: download_clip
tools.description: Save a rendered clip (.mp4) or its captions (.srt).

tools.name: download_all_clips
tools.description: Every exportable clip with covers, as one .zip.

tools.name: stop_live
tools.description: Stop watching a live stream; a last pass finishes the clips.

tools.name: more_moments
tools.description: Moments found but not made into clips, best first.

tools.name: make_clip
tools.description: Turn one of those moments into a finished clip (free).

tools.name: rename_clip
tools.description: Change a clip's title.

tools.name: caption_variants
tools.description: Copies of a clip in up to 3 other caption styles (Pro, Studio).

tools.name: post_drafts
tools.description: Ready-to-post hooks, captions and hashtags for TikTok/Shorts/Reels, X and LinkedIn. Never publishes.

tools.name: beat_edit
tools.description: Cut footage to the beat of a song (Clipper and up).

tools.name: beat_edit_status
tools.description: A Beat Edit's progress, or the recent ones.

tools.name: download_beat_edit
tools.description: Save a finished Beat Edit.

tools.name: ai_models
tools.description: AI Studio image and video models, templates, prices in credits, the account's credits.

tools.name: ai_ideas
tools.description: B-roll, hook, cover and product-shot ideas for a clip, with prompts and prices. Free.

tools.name: ai_price
tools.description: What a generation costs, without spending anything.

tools.name: ai_generate
tools.description: Start an image or video generation. Spends credits; failed jobs give them back.

tools.name: ai_status
tools.description: Queued, running, done or failed, with the wait.

tools.name: ai_list
tools.description: Generations for a clip, or the account's finished ones.

tools.name: ai_cancel
tools.description: Cancel one that hasn't started; credits come back.

tools.name: ai_download
tools.description: Save a finished image or video.

tools.name: upload_media
tools.description: Upload an image, song or short video as an AI input or cover.

tools.name: set_cover
tools.description: Set or clear a clip's cover.
